# impling: # Published impling-jar loot tables for the first six implings, extracted 2026-08-25 from the
# offline wiki snapshot 20260817 via the `osrs-cache` MCP `get_wiki_sections` + `get_wiki_section`.
# Each impling was read from BOTH pages - the creature page and the jar item page - and reconciled.
# They agree on every item, quantity and rarity for all six. The ONLY difference anywhere is row
# ORDER: on `Baby impling` the `Nothing` row sits between Hammer and Ball of wool; on
# `Baby impling jar` it sits after Anchovies. Same rate (1/10) on both. No value disagreement.
# Both pages carry the banner "The following drop rates are provided by Jagex, unless otherwise
# specified." - these are authoritative published rates, not community drop-log estimates.
# Provenance oldids (creature page / jar item page):
#   baby      Baby impling      15297388  /  Baby impling jar      15185112
#   young     Young impling     15297391  /  Young impling jar     15185154
#   gourmet   Gourmet impling   15297393  /  Gourmet impling jar   15184956
#   earth     Earth impling     15297396  /  Earth impling jar     15185247
#   essence   Essence impling   15297398  /  Essence impling jar   15184955
#   eclectic  Eclectic impling  15297390  /  Eclectic impling jar  15184359
# METHOD NOTE: the derived retrieval text the MCP returns was cross-checked against the lossless
# Parsoid HTML in `wiki.sqlite` (`pages.raw_content_zstd`, zstd streaming decompress) by counting
# <tr> in every `item-drops` table. Counts match exactly and nothing was dropped:
#   baby 19 main + 2 tertiary;  baby jar 1 jar-return + 19 main + 2 tertiary;
# The sqlite `chunks` table was NOT used - it stores truncated rendered text.
#   `preroll` is used for gourmet's Grubby key only. The wiki gives it its own "Pre-roll" section,
#   above the standard-loot table, on both the creature and the jar page. It is mechanically NOT a
#   tertiary (rolled in addition) and NOT part of the main table (including it would push the main
#   sum past 1), so it is labelled verbatim rather than forced into either bucket.
# MAIN-TABLE RARITY SUMS - every one of the six sums to exactly 1:
# Tertiary rows are independent rolls and are excluded from those sums by design.
# `Nothing` (baby, 1/10) IS A REAL TABLE ENTRY, kept deliberately. `Baby impling` Trivia (oldid
# 15297388): "This is the only impling which has a chance to give nothing when successfully
# caught." The "You manage to catch the impling and acquire some loot." message still shows.
# Encoded min=0 max=0; the wiki prints its Quantity cell as N/A. Dropping it would break the sum.
# THE EMPTY JAR IS NOT A TABLE ENTRY and is deliberately absent from the rows below. The jar pages
# have a separate "Loot > Impling jar" line: "An empty impling jar is returned when removing the
# loot, with a 10% chance of it breaking." (i.e. Impling jar x1 at 9/10.) Sourced to Mod Ash, not
# to Jagex's published table - `Baby impling jar` oldid 15185112 ref 1: Jagex, Mod Ash's Twitter
# account, 4 November 2018, archived 23 July 2019: "[What are the chances of an impling jar
# breaking when opening it?] 10% flat rate, I think." This is a mechanic on opening, applies to
# every impling jar, and is independent of which loot row was rolled.
# NOTED / VARIABLE QUANTITIES - this schema has no `noted` column, so they are recorded here.
# min/max below are the item counts as printed; the wiki flags these stacks as (noted):
#   gourmet   Lobster 4, Shark 3, Rainbow fish 5, Garden pie 6, Swordfish 3, Cooked karambwan 2
#   earth     Bucket of sand 4, Compost 6, Supercompost 2, Mithril ore 3, Coal 6, Emerald 2
#   essence   Pure essence 20 (1/10 row) and Pure essence 35 (1/100 row)
#   eclectic  Oak plank 4, Gold bar 5, Adamantite ore 10, Slayer's respite 2
# THE ONLY VARIABLE STACK in these six tables is eclectic `Air rune`, printed "30-58" -> min 30,
# max 58. Every other row is a fixed quantity (min == max).
# Two implings list the same item twice at different rates and stack sizes, which is correct and
# not a duplicate: earth `Mithril ore` (1 @ 1/10, 3 noted @ 1/100) and essence `Pure essence`
# `Strawberries(5)` and `Defence potion(3)` keep the wiki's verbatim names; the parenthesised
# number is part of the item name, not a quantity.
